rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose casual verb for physically injuring someone or a body part.

example.english: It is easy to injure your foot when playing football.
example.traditional: 踢波嗰陣好容易整傷隻腳。
example.jyutping: tek3 bo1 go2 zan6 hou2 jung4 ji6 zing2 soeng1 zek3 gok3

rows.note: Use this when someone gets physically hurt, especially accidentally or in an incident.

example.english: Be careful on the stairs so you don't injure your leg.
example.traditional: 落樓梯嗰陣小心啲，唔好整親隻腳。
example.jyutping: lok6 lau4 tai1 go2 zan6 siu2 sam1 di1 m4 hou2 zing2 can1 zek3 gok3

rows.note: Use this when the injury is caused by a collision or being hit by something.

example.english: Be careful crossing the road so a car doesn't injure you.
example.traditional: 過馬路要小心，唔好畀架車撞傷。
example.jyutping: gwo3 maa5 lou6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 m4 hou2 bei2 gaa3 ce1 zong6 soeng1

rows.note: Use this in formal or serious contexts for causing physical harm, rather than in everyday casual speech.

example.english: This chemical can injure the human body.
example.traditional: 呢種化學品會傷害人體。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 faa3 hok6 ban2 wui5 soeng1 hoi6 jan4 tai2
